title: Critical Panic Laboratory Values Notification and Escalation

steps.description: Laboratory analyzer flags test result outside critical physiological thresholds (e.g. Potassium > 6.0 mmol/L or < 2.5 mmol/L, Platelets < 20000 /uL).
Medical lab technologist immediately verifies sample integrity, performs repeat run or dilution test, and confirms validity.
Duty lab technician places telephone call directly to ward in-charge nurse or primary treating doctor within 15 minutes.
Recipient reads back patient UHID, name, test name, and numerical value; call timestamp and staff name logged in LIS.
System marks critical_value_alerted as TRUE. If recipient unreachable within 30 minutes, escalate to Operations Manager.

common_blockers: Ward telephone line engaged or nurse unable to step away from acute bedside resuscitation
Missing primary treating consultant mobile contact in EMR staff roster
Technical communication gap where critical_value_flag is set in database but alert dispatch trigger fails
